title: Natchez Balloon Race
specs: Hot air balloons launch early morning and late afternoon when wind conditions are stable
Festival site located at Rosalie Mansion's high bluffs above the Mississippi River
Live world-class musical entertainment and carnival rides and games
No pets allowed except service dogs with credentials
Sponsors at $1,400 or above may fly in balloon basket with pilot
includes: Access to live music, carnival games, local food vendors, NFL/NCAA sports tent, and arts and crafts festival
Admission to balloon glow and fireworks on Friday night
gap: Price and duration details for tethered balloon rides not stated
blurb: The festival features hot air balloon flights over downtown Natchez and the Mississippi River, live musical entertainment, carnival rides and games, and an arts and crafts market. Balloon flights occur Friday morning, Saturday morning and afternoon, and Sunday morning and afternoon, weather permitting. The festival is family-friendly and held at Rosalie Mansion's high bluffs above the Mississippi River.
extraNote: No refund on tickets under any circumstances; event held rain or shine · Tickets are not transferable and resale is prohibited · No coolers or outside food and drinks allowed on festival site · No firearms or weapons permitted on festival grounds · Event may be postponed or cancelled due to adverse weather or other causes beyond control · Festival grounds at Rosalie Mansion, Natchez, MS · October
